## Treatments
- Back, neck and joint pain (low back pain, sciatica, frozen shoulder, knee osteoarthritis)
- Sports injuries and fitness rehabilitation
- Recovery after surgery (knee and hip replacement, ACL reconstruction, fractures)
- Stroke and neurological rehabilitation (stroke, Parkinson's disease, balance problems)
- Heart and breathing rehabilitation
- Children's physiotherapy and elderly mobility (home visits in Surat)
